briefdescription.para: Callback type for post-update health checks.

detaileddescription.para: The function should return true when the system is healthy after an update, or false to signal that the update should be rolled back.
Protected (not private) so that test subclasses can access and invoke the registered callback without requiring a separate accessor.

Atomic file replacement
Automatic backup before update
Rollback capability on failure
